# issue 4036 -- source corroboration: test coverage and the
# regression window v1.6.2112 -> v1.7.2207
#
# Generated by source-window.py, which echoes every command it runs.
# Every command runs with the repository root as its working
# directory; all pathspecs are repository-relative.
# Nothing here runs the compiler; this is git evidence only.
# It supports, and does not replace, the measured per-release
# results in manual-case-release-matrix.txt.

== 1. is the construct in the repro covered by an in-tree test?
   The repro calls a method on a cast applied straight to a heap
   subscript:
       ((StructuredBuffer<float>)ResourceDescriptorHeap[i]).Load(0)
   Search every test for a cast applied straight to a heap
   subscript, i.e. the ')' of a cast immediately followed by the
   heap name.

   $ git grep -n -E \)(ResourceDescriptorHeap|SamplerDescriptorHeap)\[ HEAD -- tools/clang/test

   HEAD:tools/clang/test/HLSLFileCheck/hlsl/template/FunctionOverloads.hlsl:12:  Texture2D<T> Get() { return (Texture2D<T>)ResourceDescriptorHeap[heapId]; }
   HEAD:tools/clang/test/HLSLFileCheck/hlsl/template/InstantiateObjectMethods.hlsl:7:  Texture2D<T> Get() { return (Texture2D<T>)ResourceDescriptorHeap[heapId]; }
   HEAD:tools/clang/test/HLSLFileCheckLit/hlsl/auto/auto-no-descriptor-heap.hlsl:24:    auto sampled = tex2.Sample((SamplerState)SamplerDescriptorHeap[0], pos.xy);

   The construct does appear -- but look at what those tests run.
   Print the RUN line of each:

   $ git grep -h -n RUN: HEAD -- tools/clang/test/HLSLFileCheck/hlsl/template/FunctionOverloads.hlsl

   1:// RUN: %dxc -T ps_6_6 -E main -HV 2021 -ast-dump %s | FileCheck %s

   $ git grep -h -n RUN: HEAD -- tools/clang/test/HLSLFileCheck/hlsl/template/InstantiateObjectMethods.hlsl

   1:// RUN: %dxc -T ps_6_6 -E main -HV 2021 -ast-dump %s | FileCheck %s

   $ git grep -h -n RUN: HEAD -- tools/clang/test/HLSLFileCheckLit/hlsl/auto/auto-no-descriptor-heap.hlsl

   1:// RUN: %dxc -T ps_6_6 -HV 202x -verify %s

   The two template tests are -ast-dump: they stop after parsing.
   The auto test is -verify and its other lines expect errors, so
   compilation stops after Sema.  None of the three reaches code
   generation, which is where this issue fails.  The construct is
   present in the suite but the failing path is not exercised.

   For contrast, count the tests using the supported spelling
   (assign the subscript to a local first):

   $ git grep -l -E (ResourceDescriptorHeap|SamplerDescriptorHeap)\[ HEAD -- tools/clang/test

   HEAD:tools/clang/test/CodeGenDXIL/hlsl/attributes/coherent_flat_conversion.hlsl
   HEAD:tools/clang/test/CodeGenSPIRV/resource-heap-ext-texture.hlsl
   HEAD:tools/clang/test/CodeGenSPIRV/sm6_6.descriptorheap.acbuffer.hlsl
   HEAD:tools/clang/test/CodeGenSPIRV/sm6_6.descriptorheap.aliasing.hlsl
   HEAD:tools/clang/test/CodeGenSPIRV/sm6_6.descriptorheap.buffer.hlsl
   HEAD:tools/clang/test/CodeGenSPIRV/sm6_6.descriptorheap.byteaddressbuffer.hlsl
   ... 64 more lines, not reproduced here

   files matching: 70

   Which shape actually fails is measured, not inferred -- see
   variant-control-cast-local-main-debug--match-fails.txt (cast
   assigned to a local: compiles) and
   variant-control-cast-arg-main-debug--match-fails.txt (cast
   passed as an argument: compiles).  Only the member call on the
   cast expression itself fails.

== 4. did the failing lowering itself change in the window?
   Compare the first 80 lines of LowerGetResourceFromHeap at each tag.
   (The function moved: the line numbers differ, the text may not.)

   v1.6.2112: tools/clang/lib/CodeGen/CGHLSLMSFinishCodeGen.cpp first appears at line 183
   v1.7.2207: tools/clang/lib/CodeGen/CGHLSLMSFinishCodeGen.cpp first appears at line 214

   IDENTICAL -- all 80 lines of LowerGetResourceFromHeap are byte-equal at both
   tags.  The lowering that now throws did not change across
   the window, so whatever started producing an IR shape it
   cannot handle lies upstream of code generation.

   SELF-TEST: the comparison above must be able to report a
   difference, or 'IDENTICAL' means nothing.  Compare the same
   window against a deliberately different function to prove the
   comparison is not vacuous.

   control (LowerGetResourceFromHeap at v1.6.2112 vs FinishIntrinsics at v1.7.2207): 79 of 80 differ
   SELF-TEST pass
